{{Quote|The destruction of Lord Senu's fortress was but a prelude. Our enemy intends to purge the Empire of any Sith who lacks pure blood.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the xenophobic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]] '''attacked''' the [[Lord Senu's fortress|fortress]] of the Sith Lord [[Senu]] with his flagship ''[[Red Reaper]]''. The destruction of the fortress brought Ikoral's return to [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]] to the Empire's attention, and a [[Destruction of a Sith fortress|subsequent attack]] on another fortress caused [[Darth Malgus]] to dispatch a strike team to destroy the ''Red Reaper''.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
